title: Chapter 75
text:
Ten minutes later.

"Kacha!"

Magnu broke the soldier's neck.

They had obtained the information they wanted.

Winna said through the communication device, "We have obtained preliminary information. The security perimeter of the base is divided into six zones. This is the outermost perimeter."

"Every perimeter has a sentry post, and an officer is in charge of all the sentries in the area. According to the interrogation earlier, the officer can log into the base's intranet. Therefore, as long as we reach the sentry post, we can use the officer's computer to browse the base's intranet and collect detailed information about the enemy."

"This soldier has already revealed the location of the base. There is no time to lose. I request that we act immediately."

Ye Fan sighed. There was a system for changing shifts at the sentry post. It would take at most twenty-four hours for the enemy to discover that the sentry post had been killed. However, as long as they could get the information, it did not matter if they were exposed. The invasion of Hesla's army could not be hidden from the enemy. What they needed to do was to find out the defensive measures and military strength of the Dark Crow Valley base.

However, if Winna's operation succeeded, the Division 13 agents in Dark Crow Forest Town would be exposed. The death of the sentry post and the invasion of the town happened on the same day. Even if the Division 13 agents did not have time to commit the crime, the enemy would still suspect them.

At this moment, Ye Fan made a rational decision.

"Operation approved. Head to the enemy's base immediately."

Winna nodded, got rid of the corpse, and led the team into action.

Ye Fan heaved a sigh of relief and looked away from the screen. He looked at the office of Division 13 and shook his head slightly. His decision had nothing to do with pleasure. It was all for the sake of the mission. He would inform Division 13 later.

Who did not want to risk their life?

…

Before dawn, Winna and the rest found the sentry post.

It was a very secluded hut in the forest. It looked like a hunter's base.

The team quietly approached the hut. Magnu took out a sonar detector from his backpack and placed it on the outer wall of the hut. After activating the detector, a black and white image appeared. There were three targets in the detector. One was lying on the sofa, and the other two were sitting at the table. They seemed to be having supper.

Winna raised her finger and counted down silently.

Three, two, one! Winna jumped up and broke through the window. Her teammates followed closely behind.

The three enemies did not expect an enemy invasion. They were so shocked that they jumped up. Before they could yell or pull out their pistols, they were knocked down by three shots from the well-trained Hesla agents.

The Hesla agents immediately searched the room and the three men's clothes. They found a secret compartment in the wall with a safe inside. Another agent found an identity card on the body of an unconscious enemy. The card clearly stated that the person was a military officer.

"That's the target." Winna was overjoyed. This man was the officer in charge of the sentry post. She looked at his ID card and saw that his name was Roman. He was a black man.

The agent tied Roman up and then injected him with a sobering agent. When he slowly woke up, Magnus slapped him to speed up his recovery. He said in a low voice, "Tell me the password to the safe if you don't want to die!"

Roman was frightened by the group of fully armed agents in front of him. He hurriedly confessed, not showing the slightest bit of loyalty.

After keying in the password, the safe was successfully opened. There was a specially made laptop inside, which was not any brand on the market.

When the laptop was turned on, there was a login interface that required an identity card and a password.

Roman was very cooperative. He entered the interface through his account. Following a cheerful ringtone, a line of welcome appeared on the laptop.

"Dang, dang, dang, dang, the Germinal Organization's idiotic operation assistant is at your service."

Ye Fan, who was drinking coffee, spat it out.

All the Hesla agents' faces twitched.

This did not match the style at all!

"So … so naughty …" Ye Fan did not know if he should spit it out.

Various menus appeared on the interface. Roman's access was low, so he could only browse a small part of the menu. Winna and the rest saw the locked logs of the base and were slightly excited.

These logs contained all the information about the base.

"Let me do it." Ye Fan ordered Magnus to plug a chip into the computer. In the base, the screen in front of Ye Fan was synchronized with the computer.

Ye Fan's face suddenly became serious. His hands were like butterflies dancing in the air as he typed furiously on the keyboard.

First layer of firewall, cracked!

Second layer of firewall, cracked!

Third layer of firewall, cracked!

Internal dynamic password, cracked!

Access restrictions, cracked!

Ye Fan smiled slightly. He was an experienced hacker in Hesla. He had hundreds of different kinds of viruses in his hands. Except for some monsters on the dark web and the Great Disconnection Technique, no one could stop him from hacking.

In less than three minutes, all the locked files were opened. At this time, the enemy hackers finally reacted and started to delete the files frantically. On the other hand, Ye Fan quickly backed up the files. Both parties were racing against time.

Soon, all the files were deleted. Ye Fan's laptop was not fast enough. Even though he was very skilled, he could only back up 28% of the files. The base usually started from the classified files first.

However, it was enough. The files that Ye Fan had obtained included the distribution of the base's defense measures, internal structure, military terrain, and a large number of logs.

"It's done. Come back." Ye Fan heaved a sigh of relief.

The stolen information would definitely alert the Dark Crow Valley base. However, with the information in hand, it did not matter if they were exposed.

However, Ye Fan felt that something was off.

It seemed … a little too smooth.

…

"Sir, the external network has been hacked."

In the intelligence control room of the Dark Crow Valley base, there were many computer screens all over the place, "said a staff member.

The deputy supervisor of the base, Ji Ji, was a tall and skinny man with a gloomy face. He walked to the screen calmly and said slowly, "What data has been stolen?"

"The base's experiment logs, the internal structure of the base, the base's coordinates, the base's sentry duty changing records …"

The staff member reported more than ten key pieces of information. Although the network had been hacked, no one in the base showed any signs of panic.

"Could the intruder be from Hesla?"

"The bait has been thrown out. We are just waiting for the fish to take the bait." Ji Ji's lips curled into a mocking smile. He was like a hunter who had just seen his prey fall into the trap.

Ji Ji went to the supervisor's office and reported to Pan Kuang.

"Just now, a hacker has hacked into the external camouflage network. I think it is from Hesla.

We might be attacked by the military in the future. "Pan Kuang used a handkerchief to wipe a long black knife. The long knife was as cold as autumn. The body of the knife was straight and thick. The handle of the knife was wrapped with cloth. From the dried bloodstains on the knife, one could tell that the knife had been used for many years and had taken many lives.

Pan Kuang focused on wiping the knife as if there was nothing else in his eyes. He did not even raise his head. He only asked, "What do you think we should do?"

Ji Ji cleared his throat and said, "Although the enemy has only obtained the bait, the existence of the base has been exposed. I suggest that we ask the leader to evacuate the base and take all the resources and information with us. Before we evacuate, we should try our best to kill as many of the enemy's forces as possible."

"Okay," Pan Kuang said calmly, "If you need me to fight, just let me know."
